currentDevelopment.runtimeState: owner-installed; build loads in real Chrome. Living Eye/Search morph, drift and Ocean scene are present, but owner replaced the direct-search first interaction with a Kraken proximity-wake radial launcher model. Full subsystem regression remains open.

release.notes: Adds Ocean and Space interface modes. Ocean now wakes by cursor proximity around the Kraken eye and reveals a semicircular first-level launcher with Search, Files, Team, AI, Browser, Media, Code, Settings and Store; mouse wheel rotates the arc. Search becomes a second-level bubble. The empty-canvas welcome is session-only and closable. Ocean has Day/Night variants; Space preserves classic Light/Dark. Ocean windows use round controls and bubble-open language. Existing engine/transports/data are preserved.
